tool_calls.code:
import pandas as pd
df = pd.read_csv('focus_billing.csv')
sub = df[(df['BillingPeriodStart']=='2026-07-01') & (df['ChargeCategory']=='Usage')]
print(sub.groupby('SubAccountName')['BilledCost'].sum().sort_values(ascending=False))
total = sub['BilledCost'].sum()
print("total:", total)
top = sub.groupby('SubAccountName')['BilledCost'].sum().sort_values(ascending=False)
print("share:", top.iloc[0]/total*100)
